name: clean-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night, the kit's green plate. Our overlay over the checker's clean-truck-yard photo, cut to 1:1.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: The white semi-truck is prominently centered at a fuel stop, instantly recognizable as a tractor at phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline calls for OTR drivers and the picture shows a road-going semi-truck at a fuel stop, which is a natural OTR setting.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The dark green band makes the large headline easy to read first, but 'Apply now' sits as plain text rather than a visually distinct button, weakening the call-to-action hierarchy.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green (#0B3D2E) banner and white text match the brand's two colours exactly, though no logo is present to reinforce the carrier identity.
